BrochureContent.Content:
Brian Gleeson Property are delighted to present to the market this wonderful opportunity to acquire a delightful 4 bedroom property within ten minutes’ drive to the West Waterford capital of Dungarvan.

Sitting on circa 1 acre this spacious home offers its new owners a quality lifestyle in a sought-after residential area.

This family home in a private setting comprises of entrance hall, spacious living room with stove, kitchen/dining room, office/extra bedroom, utility and WC.  Upstairs, there are 3 bedrooms (master ensuite) and main bathroom. Outside, there is a large mature garden allowing for numerous possibilities.

The property is surrounded by spacious grounds, tranquillity and countryside scenery, all while being a short 4km from the bustling seaside town of Dungarvan. Dungarvan has many amenities including shops, various restaurants, coffee shops, schools, golf courses, beaches and of course the fantastic Waterford Greenway.

With the West Waterford Golf Club only two minutes drive from this home, it is ideal for the golfing enthusiast or those who enjoy outdoor pursuits. The well renowned Carriglea & Glenbeg National School along with the local Brickey Rangers GAA club are also only a short 2-minute drive.
This property would make the perfect family home or retirement haven. You will be assured of a warm welcome when you come to the scenic Brickey Valley.

Enjoy the pictorial essay and call us to book your private viewing.
